messages:
oliver_new: hey team — joining from singapore. quick onboarding/security q's: 1) my YubiKey shipping is delayed, can I use phone-only MFA until it arrives? 2) the Security Foundations course is in English only, any language options or captions? 3) data residency question: will my account be tied to APAC region for logs? also saw a phishing sim notice but timestamps are UTC. who do I ask about local time windows? tagging @mia_peopleops and @zoe_security

mia_peopleops: welcome Oliver! :wave: phone MFA is fine temporarily, but request a YubiKey ASAP via Okta -> MFA -> Request hardware token so we can track shipping. we can flag your account for early re-assignment once token arrives. for training, Okta Learn has captions and transcripts — if you need translations or accessibility accommodations, DM me and we can arrange an alternate format.

ryan_it: for APAC devices we mark device region metadata but logs are centrally stored in us-west. we segment some telemetry by region for compliance but your core account identity is global. if a customer contract requires APAC-only residency, security/legal will advise.

zoe_security: phishing sims are scheduled in UTC but we don't penalize timezone differences. security-bot will group new-hires into a local-friendly window based on profile timezone. if you want to opt out temporarily (e.g., for health reasons), DM me. also, please avoid storing corp artifacts on local cloud sync until KMS access is provisioned.

security-bot: PhishSim: new-user cohort assigned. Scheduled sim: 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC. Completion window: 7 days.

oliver_new: thanks — one more: do I need to sign the contractor/NDA before accessing SOC2 artifacts or can I request a redacted pack?

access-admin: SOC2 access requires an internal NDA + approval. for new hires it's auto-approved once you finish Security Foundations and MFA is enrolled. we can provide a redacted SOC2 summary sooner on request; DM with the reason and we'll expedite.

oliver_new: perfect. i'll request the YubiKey and finish the Okta module today. thanks all :)
